summary: Alpha Compute Corp filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) on July 20, 2026, attaching a press release dated July 17, 2026, announcing the appointment of Enzo Villani as President, effective July 15, 2026. Mr. Villani, already Executive Chairman and Chief Investment Officer, retains those roles with continued CIO duties under a newly formed President’s Office. The transition broadens his responsibility for corporate strategy and operational execution, alongside CEO Brittany Kaiser. No other terms, board recommendation, or advisors are named. The filing notes no expected change to strategy or guidance. Watch for further management integration or strategic shifts.
